name: SC Conservation Bank land protection grants
summary: Grants to qualified land trusts, government agencies and other eligible entities for buying land or conservation easements that protect forests, wetlands, farmland and natural areas in South Carolina. Landowners cannot apply directly.

steps: Eligibility check as a qualified entity, before portal access

eligibility.rule: A funded conservation easement is held by an eligible trust fund recipient
If a nonprofit, its principal activity is acquiring and managing land for conservation or historic preservation

documents: Letter of intent or purchase contract

calls.label: Quarterly application rounds

status.quote: Please refer to these quarterly deadlines for the first part, the Application Phase: January 31 April 30 July 31 October 31

recurring.quote: Please refer to these quarterly deadlines for the first part, the Application Phase: January 31 April 30 July 31 October 31

calls.recurring: Application deadlines each quarter: January 31, April 30, July 31 and October 31.

administered_by.quote: The South Carolina Conservation Bank works with government agencies, land trusts, and other eligible entities to conserve and protect South Carolina's beautiful natural resources

applicant_types.quote: government agencies, not-for-profits, land trusts, and other eligible entities with whom we fulfill our mission.

geography.quote: The South Carolina Conservation Bank improves the quality of life in South Carolina by conserving significant forest lands, farmlands, wetlands, historical properties, archaeological sites, and urban parks.

access.quote: Applications must be submitted through the Online Application Portal

window.quote: Please refer to these quarterly deadlines for the first part, the Application Phase: January 31 April 30 July 31 October 31

effort.quote: The Bank has established an internal procedure to verify applicant eligibility and, if applicable, to collect necessary documentation prior to creating a "New Organization" on the Bank's online application portal.

eligibility.quote: The South Carolina Conservation Bank Act requires that any conservation easement funded by the Bank must be held by an eligible trust fund recipient.
Has a principal activity of acquiring and managing land interests for conservation or historic preservation

documents.quote: A copy of the letter of intent or purchase contract that reflects the transaction contemplated in this application.
A commitment to insure title to the real estate interests subject to this application.

A Preliminary Appraisal, which should include a brief description of comparable sales, if applicable, and analysis used to arrive at the value of the property interest subject to this application. Baseline Report Documentation or Land Management Plan, if available Photographs (two minimum) Maps and/or GIS Shapefiles Landowner Acknowledgement, signed Match Agreement, signed, if applicable
